en-US.description: 🐱 Cross-platform desktop pet BongoCat, adding fun to your desktop!
en-US.longDescription:
🐱 Cross-platform desktop pet BongoCat, adding fun to your desktop!
Features:
- Compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux (x11).
- Synchronizes mouse movements or keyboard taps based on your keyboard or mouse actions.
- Supports importing custom models to freely create your unique cat avatar.
- Fully open-source with transparent code—absolutely no user data collection.
- Works offline—no internet required, ensuring user privacy.
en-US.releaseNotes:
✨ Features
- Added a "Show every held key" setting under Input & interaction → Keyboard.
- Improved the macOS Input Monitoring permission flow with a guided panel that walks you through the authorization.
🐛 Bug Fixes
- Fixed some BongoCat Mver models failing to import with an "invalid model package" message.
- Fixed BongoCat freezing and quitting on Windows after clicking "Report an issue".
- Fixed the menu bar icon missing on macOS after updating to a new version and restarting.
- Fixed Xbox-mode controllers going unresponsive on Windows once another window took focus.
- Fixed flickering on Windows when a model uses a gamepad mode.
- Fixed dropdown menus in Settings being too narrow to show their options.
🌍 Localization
Added Korean.

zh-CN.description: 🐱 跨平台桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
zh-CN.longDescription:
🐱 跨平台桌宠 BongoCat，为桌面增添乐趣！
功能介绍
- 适配 macOS、Windows 和 Linux (x11)。
- 根据据键盘或鼠标操作，同步移动鼠标或敲击键盘。
- 支持导入自定义模型，自由打造专属猫咪形象。
- 完全开源，代码公开透明，绝不收集任何用户数据。
- 支持离线运行，无需联网，保护用户隐私。
zh-CN.name: BongoCat
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
✨ 新功能
- 新增「输入与交互 → 键盘 → 同时显示所有按下的键」配置项。
- 优化 macOS「输入监控」权限授权流程：新增悬浮引导面板，引导完成权限授权。
🐛 问题修复
- 修复部分 BongoCat Mver 模型无法导入并提示「模型包无效」的问题。
- 修复 Windows 上点击「反馈问题」后应用闪退的问题。
- 修复 macOS 更新到新版本并重启后菜单栏图标不显示的问题。
- 修复 Windows 上 Xbox 模式手柄在其他窗口获得焦点后无响应的问题。
- 修复 Windows 上使用手柄模式模型时闪烁的问题。
- 修复设置窗口中下拉菜单宽度不足的问题。
🌍 本地化
- 新增韩语本地化。
